newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: BIB takes 80 pct in U.S. Sarah Michaels.
newsitem.headline: BIB takes 80 pct in U.S. Sarah Michaels.

text.p: Bahrain International Bank EC, an offshore banking unit, said on Monday it acquired an 80 percent stake in Sarah Michaels Inc, a U.S. bath products company.
BIB did not give the total cost of the deal but described the purchase as its most significant move in 1997.
"Sarah Michaels' strong U.S. sales base will provide an ideal platform for expanding the Sarah Michaels brand worldwide in coming years," it said in a statement.
"We plan to continue the company's impressive growth through expanded distribution and the introduction of new products."
BIB, which was established in 1982, is an international investment bank with offices in Bahrain, the United States, London and Dublin.
Last year, it said it acquired for $86.5 million all the equity of Carrols Holding Corp, parent company of Carrols Corp, the largest independent Burger King franchisee in the U.S.
